description: This source file implements the main logic for generating a host bug report in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It includes functions for collecting logs, device bug reports via ADB, and packaging them into a ZIP archive, with command-line options for customization.

classes.name: ZipWriter
classes.description: A class for writing ZIP archives, supporting starting and finishing entries, and writing bytes.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A template class representing the result of an operation, which can be successful or contain an error.

methods.name: SaveFile
methods.description: Saves a file into the ZIP archive at the specified path.

methods.name: AddNetsimdLogs
methods.description: Adds netsim logs to the ZIP archive if available.

methods.name: CreateDeviceBugreport
methods.description: Creates a bug report from a connected device via ADB and stores it in the specified output directory.

methods.name: CvdHostBugreportMain
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the collection of logs, device reports, and packaging into a ZIP archive.
